scientific_integrity: Exact population-sector theorem for stationary independent symmetric telegraph hopping; no claims of independent verification or exhaustive publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous nonzero hopping, equal positive independent switching rates, localized preparation, ensemble-averaged site populations and logarithmic asymptotic rate only; excludes correlated noise, site noise, additional baths, finite-time objectives.
title: Preparation-dependent optimal telegraph switching on a three-site quantum chain
